bot.start: Hi {name}! 👋 Welcome to {restaurant}. Here you can see the menu, book a table and manage your bookings. Pick an option below 👇
bot.help:
Here's what I can do:

{menu} – see the menu
{book} – book in a few steps
{info} – where we are and when we're open
{my_bookings} – see or cancel your bookings

Commands: /start, /book, /menu, /info, /bookings, /stop, /language, /myid
bot.help_owner:
👨‍🍳 Owner commands:
/today – today's bookings
/week – bookings for the next 7 days
bot.my_id: Your chat_id is: {chat_id} If you are the owner, copy it into the .env file as OWNER_CHAT_ID and restart the bot to receive booking notifications.
bot.menu_footer: For allergens and intolerances, please ask our staff.
bot.book_start: Great, let's book a table! 🍽 You can stop at any time with /stop. 1/5 – What name is the booking under?
bot.name_invalid: Please enter a valid name (2 to 50 characters).
bot.ask_people: 2/5 – How many people? Pick a number or type it.
bot.people_invalid:
Please type a number of people between 1 and {max}.
For larger groups, give us a call 📞
bot.ask_date: 3/5 – Which day? Pick {today} or {tomorrow}, or type a date (e.g. 25/12, day/month).
bot.date_invalid: I didn't get the date 🤔 Please write it as dd/mm or dd/mm/yyyy, e.g. 25/12.
bot.date_past: That date has already passed. Please pick another one 🙂
bot.date_too_far: We take bookings up to {days} days in advance. Please pick an earlier date.
bot.date_closed: Sorry, we're closed on {weekday}s 😔 Please pick another day.
bot.no_slots_today: There are no more times available today. Please pick another day.
bot.time_invalid:
Please pick one of the available times with the buttons below 👇
Times: {slots}
bot.ask_notes: 5/5 – Would you like to add a note? For example allergies, a high chair, a special occasion… Type it or tap {no_notes}.
bot.notes_too_long: The note is too long (max {max} characters). Please shorten it.
bot.slot_gone: Oops, that time is no longer available. Let's start again 🙏
bot.flow_cancelled: Booking stopped. I'm here whenever you need me 🙂
bot.unexpected:
I didn't understand 🤔 Please answer the question above with the buttons or by typing.
To stop the booking, use /stop.
bot.my_none:
You have no upcoming bookings.
Tap «{book}» to book a table!
bot.not_found: Booking not found or already cancelled.
bot.cancel_ask: Do you really want to cancel booking no. {id} on {date} at {time}?
bot.cancel_done: ✅ Booking no. {id} on {date} at {time} has been cancelled.
bot.cancel_kept: OK, your booking is still on 👍
bot.cancelled_by_restaurant: 😔 We're sorry, your booking no. {id} on {date} at {time} ({people}) has been cancelled by the restaurant.
bot.call_us: For information you can call us on {phone}.
bot.nothing_to_cancel:
There is no booking in progress to stop.
To cancel a confirmed booking, go to «{my_bookings}».
bot.unknown: I didn't understand 🤔 Use the buttons below to choose what to do, or type /help to see all the commands.
bot.error: Something went wrong 😓 Please try again in a moment or type /start.
bot.language_ask: Which language would you like me to use?
bot.language_set: Great, I'll write to you in English from now on 🇬🇧

owner.week_title: 🗓 Bookings for the next 7 days from {start} to {end}
